onset.Description: Onset in seconds from the first stored EEG sample. The source CSV files contain no nonzero task markers, so values are n/a rather than inferred.

duration.Description: Duration reported for each motor-imagery or break block in the study protocol.

trial_type.Description: Motor-imagery or break condition reported by the study protocol.

Levels.right_hand: Imagined movement of the right hand.
Levels.right_leg: Imagined movement of the right leg.
Levels.left_hand: Imagined movement of the left hand.
Levels.left_leg: Imagined movement of the left leg.
Levels.break: Break period without instructed movement imagery.

protocol_session.Description: One-based video-session number within the continuous recording.

block_in_session.Description: One-based task-block order within the protocol video session.
